name: Rock Prairie Marketplace
summary: Rock Prairie Marketplace is a 31,603 square foot retail center located at a premier intersection in south College Station, directly adjacent to the Baylor Scott & White medical campus. The property offers excellent Highway 6 visibility and serves a growing, affluent market anchored by Texas A&M University.
demographics: Rock Prairie Marketplace serves a highly educated, affluent community in College Station, Texas, anchored by Texas A&M University. The trade area features a median household income of $65,172 within 10 miles, with the immediate 1-mile radius showing stronger affluence at $84,915. The center attracts a mix of university-affiliated professionals, medical staff from the adjacent Baylor Scott & White campus, and growing suburban families. The daytime population significantly exceeds residential population, indicating strong commuter traffic and employment centers nearby, with over 286,000 daytime workers within 10 miles creating robust weekday shopping patterns.
description: Rock Prairie Marketplace is a premier shopping destination strategically positioned at the southeast corner of Highway 6 and Rock Prairie Road in College Station, Texas. This 31,603 square foot retail center benefits from exceptional visibility along Highway 6, one of the area's primary commercial corridors, and enjoys a prime location directly adjacent to the Baylor Scott & White medical campus, which includes a 320,000 square foot hospital and 120,000 square foot clinic. The center serves the rapidly growing south College Station market, an area experiencing significant residential and commercial development driven by Texas A&M University's continued expansion. With a parking ratio of 5.41 spaces per 1,000 square feet, the property offers ample convenience for shoppers and medical visitors alike. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, Rock Prairie Marketplace represents a well-maintained retail asset in a high-growth Texas market with strong demographic fundamentals and excellent access to both residential neighborhoods and major employment centers.
